name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Hale's grade is at least 4% more than the class with Jonah.
Boyd goes with exactly two of English, Library, Jonah, and 84%.
The class in the Cloister has a higher grade than the class with Quinn.
Carver has a higher grade than the French class.
The class with Jonah's grade is immediately next to the English class.
